title: Visits
description: Private visits to Casa Meyer by appointment.

blocks.html: Casa Meyer is a private home. Small groups are received on visiting days, and every visit is booked at least eight weeks in advance. Choose a day and a time below.

Visits are led in English or Spanish and follow the sequence of walls, light and colour as Barragán laid it out, from the yellow gate through the house to the garden. Photography for personal use is welcome unless a visit says otherwise. [Days, hours, group sizes and prices to be confirmed.]
